description: What a preview samples from: the unsaved evaluation's conditions and target.

allows_na.description: Whether the evaluation can return N/A for non-applicable generations.

conditions.description: Optional trigger conditions to filter which events are sampled.

items.description: A trigger condition set, as on an evaluation. The id is optional here.

id.description: Identifier of this condition set, if any.

properties.description: Property filters (event or person) that scope which generations match this condition set.

rollout_percentage.description: Percentage (0-100) of matching events to sample for this evaluation. Defaults to 100.

output_config.description: Output settings used to validate the preview, including bounds, categories, and allows_na.

allows_na.description: Whether the evaluation can return N/A for non-applicable generations.

decision_threshold.description: Boolean decision-model judges only. Minimum probability of true required for a true result, inclusive. Omit or set null to use 0.5. Applies to new runs; historical results are unchanged.

max.description: Inclusive maximum numeric score. Omit for no upper bound. Required for numeric decision models and must exceed min.

min.description: Inclusive minimum numeric score. Omit for no lower bound. Required for numeric decision models.

options.description: Categorical output options. Keys identify stored results; labels are displayed to users.

operator.description: Pass at or above (gte), or at or below (lte), the threshold.

threshold.description: Finite passing threshold within any configured score bounds.

categories.description: Passing category keys. With keys selected, results must be non-empty and contain only these keys. If no passing keys are selected, only an empty result passes.

passing_rule.description: Optional numeric or categorical passing rule. Null removes the rule; historical results use the current rule.

selection_mode.description: Select one category or multiple categories. Multiple selection allows an empty result. Defaults to single.

step.description: Optional positive input increment. Does not round evaluation results.

true_is_failure.description: Boolean output only. Omit for numeric, categorical, and sentiment output. Whether a true result means the evaluation found a problem. False (the default) suits pass/fail evaluations, where a true result satisfied the criteria. Set it to true for detector-style evaluations, so a true result is counted and labeled as a fail.

output_type.description:
Expected output: boolean, numeric, or categorical. Sentiment is not supported by Hog.

* `boolean` - Boolean (Pass/Fail)
* `numeric` - Numeric
* `categorical` - Categorical

sample_count.description: Number of recent $ai_generation events to test against (1–10, default 5).

sample_ids.description: Test exactly these units instead of sampling: generation event UUIDs, trace IDs, or session IDs, matching `target`. Up to 10, and only units from the last 7 days. Conditions and sampling are ignored for pinned units, and unknown IDs are skipped. A session target tests at most 3 sessions.

source.description: Hog source code to test. Return a boolean, finite number, or category keys matching output_type. Categorical single selection accepts one key or a one-item list; multiple selection accepts a list, including []. Return null only for allowed N/A. Output settings determine which boolean counts as a failure.

target.description:
What the evaluation runs against: 'generation' samples individual generations, 'trace' samples whole traces, and 'session' samples whole sessions that have gone quiet. Each target runs against the same globals it would run against online.

* `generation` - Generation
* `trace` - Trace
* `session` - Session

target_config.description: Target-specific preview settings. For a trace target, set window_seconds between 10 and 7200.

quiet_period_seconds.description: For session samples: only sessions with no activity for this long are previewed, matching when a session evaluation would actually run. Defaults to 3600.

strategy.description:
The evaluation's settle strategy. A session evaluation with a fixed window is previewed on sessions that have been quiet for `window_seconds`, otherwise for `quiet_period_seconds`.

* `fixed_window` - Fixed window
* `inactivity` - Inactivity

window_seconds.description: Aggregation window in seconds. A trace preview defaults to 1800 and uses at most 7200.
